requirement: A private directory teardown cannot remove no longer stops it before the site's SMTP rule, network and job records

oracle.ref: PR #893 (fix); fix evidence: 05/10/2026, twice: deleting a site whose install had failed stopped at teardown step 3 (bare rm -rf under set -e: 'Directory not empty' on webroot-baseline.git), so its SMTP rule, its <label>_default network and /24 and its private directory all stayed on the host (ledger L14b, reproduced 1/1). Red 6c8278be0 (exit 1 at step 3, no iptables call, network left), fix 57f76e126.
oracle.invariant: S1 exits 0 with '# fail 0' and '# pass' equal to '# tests' (at least 23). Every named case is 'ok' (none 'not ok', none '# SKIP'): a directory that will not go at first is tried once more after a short wait and the teardown finishes; one that never goes is reported with rm's reason, steps 4 (subnet SMTP rule), 4b (network) and 5 still run, and the run exits 1 naming what is left instead of torn_down=1; the site's own network still goes and only that one.
